description: Global Fishing Watch vessel events over a date range — apparent fishing, encounters between vessels at sea, loitering, port visits and AIS gaps (transmission switched off). Each event carries its position, start/end time and the vessels involved. Answers "where was this vessel fishing", "did it meet another vessel at sea", "did it go dark". Requires your own free GFW API token, passed as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your own Global Fishing Watch API token (BYO). Get one free for non-commercial use at globalfishingwatch.org/our-apis/tokens: sign in, request an API access token, and pass it here.

offset.description: Skip this many events (default 0). Events page by offset; the response returns next_offset.

vessel_id.description: GFW vessel id from gfwfish_vessels_search (comma-separate for several). Omit to search all vessels in the window.

name: gfwfish_events
